author: Palocos
body:
Oh no! 900m xp, that's so much /s

If only there were some kind of bosses that you could raid. And they would like give you raid boss xp values.

And if only there were some kind of vessel that could lead your way to other high level people who summoned raid bosses and carried you?

It's mind blowing. He is probably hacking NF server and giving himself 10x xp modifier. That must be it!

OP you are petty and uninformed. If he doesn't have more kills or dungeons than you, obviously he isn't cheating and he got the extra xp from private/wayvessel raids or from pvp. 

Or, it could be that you are such a noob that you forgot that this game REQUIRES the use of coins and xp potion at all times, hence he could be higher lv than you with half the kills.

Edit: And how the hell would you know what his xp modifier is for dungeons? I don't wear my farming gear in world unless I'm taking train/car. I wear my view distance gear like civilized people.

author: SpindatheMH
body:
Are you in the same party? Its possible he has private raid bosses up, at which point if he solos then would be like 300 million each, so he would only need to kill three to hit that.

If you’re in the same party then you would’ve seen the raid bosses if they were private, but if not then this is possible.

body: I mean.. he could have been right on the cusp of dinging his first of those levels, and between arena, and personal raids thats not unheard of. From what I can tell bots and the such are more common than straight up changing EXP levels. If he could do that he would likely be 250.

author: Loukhi
body: His raid bosses were set to private and he killed 3 that he had been working on. Or he has a high level buddy who has a bunch of raid bosses that he popped all at once. It's not that hard at that level, it's a sweet spot for a big level jump. My main went from 176 to 182 in about 5 minutes from doing exactly that.

author: Throwaway1037492029
body:
He could be playing when you aren't, and is doing raids more frequently than you. I've averaged anywhere from 300M to 500m, with the very rare 600m thrown in there. It's not unreasonable. It's not easy, but none of what you stated is definitive proof of such.

Kingdom raids of low levels are easy to solo. So he could also do that and get about 10m-20m per kingdom raid
